name: B-2 Spirit
summary: Tailless stealth flying-wing heavy bomber based at Whiteman AFB; one of the rarest and most recognizable aircraft in the US inventory.

wings: Pure flying wing with no separate fuselage
Straight swept leading edge with a sawtooth W-shaped trailing edge
engines: Four engines buried inside the wing, two on each side of the center
Jagged intakes on the upper surface of the wing
Exhausts recessed in trenches on top of the wing trailing edge
fuselage: Raised central hump holding the cockpit with small angular windows
tail: No vertical or horizontal tail at all
Control surfaces along the sawtooth trailing edge

tellTales: Bat-like flying wing with no tail
Engine intakes on top of the wing either side of a central hump

confusedWith.howToTell: The B-2 is a tailless flying wing with no fuselage; the B-1B is a long-bodied swing-wing bomber with a tall fin.
